class.name: OcgGceMakerotation
class.brief_description: This class implements elementary construction algorithms for a rotation in 3D space. The result is a gp_Trsf transformation. A MakeRotation object provides a framework for: - defining the construction of the transformation, - implementing the construction algorithm, and - consulting the result.
